name: Feature Request
about: Propose a new feature or enhancement
title: "[FEAT] "
labels: enhancement

---

## Problem This Solves

A clear description of the problem or limitation that motivates this feature.
Example: "The crawler cannot handle applications that require a Bearer token for authentication..."

## Proposed Solution

Describe the solution you would like. Be specific about the expected behaviour and any
new CLI flags, configuration variables, or output changes.

## Alternatives Considered

Describe any alternative solutions or workarounds you have considered and why you
rejected them.

## Additional Context

Any relevant links, references, related issues, or examples from other tools.
